issues.description: [suggestion] One-tap "Order on Blinkit/Zepto" per shopping-list item. Problem: ShoppingList.tsx (route /shopping-list) auto-builds the weekly grocery list from the diet plan but the only action is Share2 — user still has to manually re-type every item name into a delivery app search bar (India users overwhelmingly use 10-min grocery delivery, not weekly big-basket shops). Evidence: grep of src/ finds zero references to blinkit/zepto/instamart/bigbasket — no delivery hook exists anywhere in the app despite the shopping list already being structured per-item with name+qty+unit. Comparable trackers (HealthifyMe, Cult.fit) don't solve this either, so it is a real differentiator, not catch-up. v1 scope: per unchecked item, a small icon button opens a deep link / web search URL for Blinkit (blinkit.com/s/?q=<item>) and Zepto (zeptonow.com/search?query=<item>) in a new tab/app — no cart-injection API (neither platform exposes one publicly), just pre-filled search, so item + qty must still be added manually by the user in the delivery app. Optional "Copy full list" fallback for the checked-but-missing items. Effort: small — 1 new button component in ShoppingList.tsx + 2 URL builders, no backend change.

issues.description:
[bug-hunt] Onboarding pregnancy/postpartum SAFETY pace-block is dead code — pregnant/nursing users get an unsafe deficit plan with no warning.

Area: onboarding pace sanity gate (src/lib/onboarding-pace.ts + src/pages/onboarding/Screen4_Goal.tsx).

The pace gate defines medical hard-blocks REJECT_PREGNANCY_DEFICIT (block ANY deficit while pregnant/nursing) and REJECT_POSTPARTUM_PACE (block >0.5%/wk), surfaced via isMedicalBlock() and gated in Screen4_Goal.canProceed. Both branches only fire when data.pregnancy_status is 'pregnant'/'nursing'/'postpartum'.

But pregnancy_status is NEVER collected during onboarding:
- OnboardingFlow.tsx:290 initializes it to "none".
- No onboarding screen ever calls updateData({pregnancy_status}) — grep-provable. The only screen that asked it, Screen5_Health, is commented OUT of the shipped condensed flow (ScreenC_HealthFood.tsx:5 — "Health Check sub-step removed per request").
- pregnancy_status is listed in DEFERRED_INTAKE_KEYS (OnboardingFlow.tsx:576), i.e. deliberately EXCLUDED from the /onboarding/responses batch and left for the post-onboarding coach-intake drip (coach-intake-questions.ts:370).

Net effect: evaluateOnboardingPace() always sees pregnancy_status='none', so isMedicalBlock() can never be true during onboarding. A pregnant/nursing user picking fat_loss with a calorie deficit passes the gate and the deficit plan is generated at finalize — the medical safeguard the code builds is inert. Pregnancy is only asked LATER (coach drip), after the unsafe plan already exists.

Expected: a pregnant/nursing user is prevented from (or at minimum warned before) generating a deficit plan at onboarding, per onboarding-pace.ts docstring + MEDICAL_BLOCK_CODES intent.
Actual: no question, no block, no warning — unsafe deficit plan generated.

Repro: run the release condensed onboarding as a female user; on the Goal tab pick fat_loss with goal_weight < current_weight and any date. Observe there is no pregnancy question anywhere in the flow and Continue is never gated by a medical block.

Suggested fix: collect pregnancy_status minimally in the shipped flow (e.g. a female-conditional one-tap on the Body/Goal tab) so the existing medical pace-block re-arms; OR if collection is intentionally deferred, remove the now-unreachable medical-block code path so the gate isn't presented as active.

issues.description: [suggestion] Quick-add "Recent meals" row for one-tap re-logging of frequently eaten foods. Problem: meal logging (FoodSearchSheet) requires a full search+select+qty flow every time, even for the same dal/roti/protein-shake a user eats daily — the highest-frequency action in the app has the highest friction, which is a known churn driver in nutrition trackers (MyFitnessPal/Cronometer both ship "recent" and "favorites" as their #1 speed feature). Evidence: grepped src/pages/_components/nutrition + components/plan-builder — no favorites/recent/quick-add/log-again surface exists anywhere in the logging flow today. Proposed v1: backend endpoint returning the user’s last 8 distinct logged foods (query existing meal-log table, group by food_id, order by last-logged desc) + a "Recent" chip row atop FoodSearchSheet; tapping re-logs the same food/qty at current time via the existing log-meal endpoint (no new write path). Effort: ~1 backend endpoint (S) + ~1 FE component insert (S), no schema change — half-day.

issues.description: [suggestion] Injury-aware exercise substitution when a plan is paused for injury. Problem: PlanPauseScreen (src/pages/PlanPauseScreen.tsx) already has an "Injury" pause reason but only stores it as a label — no body-part capture and no downstream effect, so on resume the workout plan generator/coach can re-serve the exact movement that caused the injury (e.g. shoulder press after a shoulder injury). Evidence: REASONS array has injury as a flat enum value with no follow-up field; workout-plan generation and AI coach have no injury-exclusion input anywhere in the codebase. Comparable apps (Fitbod, Future) ask which body part and auto-avoid loading it. V1 scope: when reason=injury, show one extra step "Which area?" (shoulder/knee/back/wrist/ankle/other) + optional note; store on the pause record; on resume, pass the flagged body part(s) to the workout-plan builder/coach system prompt to exclude/soften exercises targeting that area for the first 1-2 weeks back, with a banner reminding the user to clear it manually if resolved sooner. Effort: ~1-2 days (1 new field + storage, 1 builder-prompt condition, 1 UI step).
